entities.name: Query Ppnp enzyme
observations: 104 aa protein; sequence contains Pfam Ppnp domain PF06865.18 at residues 11–102.
Best reviewed homologs are bacterial pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases with 60.6–65.0% identity and approximately complete coverage.
Function assignment is moderate homology support, not direct biochemical characterization of this exact sequence.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: nucleoside + inorganic phosphate ⇌ free nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Supported substrate examples include purine nucleosides and, in reviewed homologs, uridine, cytidine, and thymidine.
Representative reactions include adenosine + phosphate ⇌ adenine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate and guanosine + phosphate ⇌ guanine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
